verdict.rationale: The evidence shows nearby access controls but no per-device pairing or approval step before a new device can view or control the screen. Hosts can restrict which apps connected guests may see, admins can provision guests and team members, and sessions can be shared by link. None of these documents a gate that holds a new device until it is paired or approved, so they are adjacent controls only.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
